remote=pathlib.Path('/mnt/si0021787ci2/default/lzq/deepresearch/deltatrace_rl_20260922/receipts/incident37-external-CPU-postmortem-source-20261011-v1')

files={'capture_cpu_shard.py': '', 'run_external_postmortem.py': ''}
for name,value in files.items():
 data=base64.b64decode(value);(remote/name).write_bytes(data)
sys.path.insert(0,str(remote))
from capture_cpu_shard import capture,SHARD_BYTES,ROW_BYTES,ANCHOR_ROWS,LOCAL_ROW
anchors={row:hashlib.sha256(str(row).encode()).digest()*2 for row in ANCHOR_ROWS};expected=hashlib.shake_256(b'external-reader-capability-only').digest(ROW_BYTES)

 pointer=ctypes.addressof(ctypes.c_char.from_buffer(buffer));os.write(writefd,str(pointer).encode());os.close(writefd);os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGSTOP);os._exit(0)
os.close(writefd);pointer=int(os.read(readfd,128));os.close(readfd);os.waitpid(pid,os.WUNTRACED)
